item.title: Racing on TV, February 20-22
item.description: NASCAR in Atlanta, Supercars and more on RACER Network. Here's what's on and when...

item.title: Camara stays fast as F2 test concludes; Herta fourth in final session
item.description: Rafael Camara set the fastest time of the Barcelona test on the third and final morning of Formula 2 pre-season testing for Invicta Racing. The Brazilian’s 1m23.252s was good enough to put him top by a quarter of a second over Campos Racing’s Noel Leon and Nikola Tsolov, who rounded...

item.title: IndyCar expands global broadcast presence for 2026
item.description: IndyCar has announced plans to broaden its international broadcast efforts for the 2026 NTT IndyCar Series season with new media and broadcast relationships that will allow audiences in more than 200 countries and territories to follow the action.

item.title: Le Mans reveals provisional 2026 24 Hours entry list
item.description: The first provisional entry list for the 2026 Le Mans 24 Hours has been revealed today by The Automobile Club de l'Ouest.

item.title: Paul Gentilozzi on going from joyriding at 13 to a 5-time Trans Am champ
item.description: This week on Racers Unchained, Paul Tracy sits down with Trans Am icon Paul Gentilozzi for one of the wildest origin stories you’ll ever hear.

item.title: Rossi ends Phoenix IndyCar test on top
item.description: Alexander Rossi completed a clean sweep of the Wednesday sessions to close out the two-day IndyCar test at Phoenix Raceway

item.title: Ferrari innovation catches the eye as Mercedes again leads McLaren in F1 pre-season testing
item.description: An innovative rear wing solution from Ferrari received plenty of attention on day two of the final pre-season test in Bahrain, as Mercedes again marginally beat McLaren to the fastest time.

item.title: After saying PU pushback ‘not worth the fight,’ Mercedes’ Wolff reacts sharply to questions about fuel
item.description: Toto Wolff says it is not worth Mercedes fighting the other manufacturers over a proposed change to the way compression ratios are tested in Formula 1, but the Mercedes team principal then reacted angrily to further questions relating to its fuel homologation.

item.title: F1’s Domenicali urges fans to wait and see how the new cars perform
item.description: Formula 1 President and CEO Stefano Domenicali says the majority of fans will not be able to notice significant differences in driving style required by the 2026 cars and is confident the new regulations will deliver great racing.

item.title: Joe Gibbs Racing sues former crew chief Gabehart, claiming theft of IP
item.description: The team has filed a federal lawsuit against former competition director Chris Gabehart, alleging a scheme to steal the organization’s information.
